summary: List pending enrollment requests with `flightctl get enrollmentrequests --field-selector="status.approval.approved != true"` and approve one with `flightctl approve -l key=value enrollmentrequest/<name>`; device names are a base32 hash of the agent's public key and cannot be changed.
questions: How do I approve a device enrollment request on the CLI?
How do I list pending Edge Manager enrollment requests?
Can I rename an Edge Manager device?
How do I add labels while approving a device?

answer_card.title: Approve device enrollment with flightctl
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
# pending requests
flightctl get enrollmentrequests --field-selector="status.approval.approved != true"
# approve, optionally labelling the device
flightctl approve -l region=eu-west-1 -l site=factory-berlin enrollmentrequest/<name>
```
The service then issues the management certificate and adds the device to the inventory. The device name (base32 hash of its public key) cannot be changed.
